name: Faunova
tagline: The operating system for the animals your enterprise is responsible for
positioning: Faunova unifies biometrics, care logs, and compliance for every animal across your facilities into one auditable system of record.

hero.h1: Every animal, accounted for. Across every facility you run.
hero.sub: Faunova is the enterprise system of record for animal care — connecting biometric sensors, care protocols, and audit-grade compliance into one platform your operators and regulators can trust.

features.title: Unified animal ledger
features.description: Retire the tangle of spreadsheets and paper charts. Every feeding, medication, and vet note writes to one immutable record per animal, per site.

features.title: Live biometric telemetry
features.description: Wearable and enclosure sensors stream weight, activity, and temperature into Faunova, flagging anomalies before a caretaker walks the floor.

features.title: Audit-ready compliance
features.description: Generate USDA and welfare-inspection packets in minutes, with a timestamped trail for every intervention across your entire operation.

features.title: Protocol automation
features.description: Codify your care standards once. Faunova schedules tasks, escalates missed steps, and routes them to the right team on every shift.

features.title: Multi-facility rollups
features.description: Regional directors see occupancy, health trends, and staffing load across hundreds of locations from a single executive dashboard.

features.title: Access governance
features.description: Role-based permissions and SSO keep sensitive medical and lineage data locked to the staff and auditors who actually need it.

testimonials.quote: We migrated 14,000 animal records off paper in a quarter. Faunova gave our welfare board a single source of truth we can defend in any inspection.
testimonials.name: Dr. Maren Holloway

testimonials.quote: Before Faunova, reconciling care logs across 60 shelters was a full-time job. Now the compliance packet builds itself and my directors sleep at night.
testimonials.name: Elias Trần

testimonials.quote: The biometric alerts caught a metabolic decline days before our team would have. At our scale, that early warning is worth the contract on its own.
testimonials.name: Priya Ramachandran
